title: Animal charity serving Rochdale seeks stallholders for Christmas fairs
excerpt: PAWS is inviting stallholders to apply for December events in Uppermill and Todmorden, supporting a rescue charity whose work includes Rochdale.
body:
An animal rescue charity serving Rochdale is inviting stallholders to take part in two Christmas events in December.

Pennine Animal Welfare Society, known as PAWS, has spaces available at its fair in Uppermill on Sunday 6 December and a second event in Todmorden on Saturday 12 December. Wendy Priest, writing on behalf of PAWS, asked interested stallholders to apply by text on 07833 736325.

The Uppermill fair will run from 11am to 3.30pm at the Civic Hall, Lee Street, OL3 6AE. Its supplied poster lists arts and craft stalls, a pop up café, Santa’s grotto, a tombola and a Christmas raffle.

PAWS lists the Todmorden event on its website as a Christmas coffee morning and fair at Central Methodist Church, Union Street, OL14 5AW, from 10.30am to 12.30pm.

Both venues are outside Rochdale borough. The charity’s rescue and rehoming work covers Rochdale as well as neighbouring areas, making the appeal relevant to local makers and traders who want to support an animal welfare organisation working in their community.

The submission does not give stall fees or booking conditions. Applicants can use the charity’s text number to enquire about availability and the terms before booking.

What locally made gifts would you like to see at a charity Christmas fair? Share your suggestions in the comments.

Sources: Wendy Priest for Pennine Animal Welfare Society, submission and event poster supplied on 14 November 2026; PAWS events listing: https://www.pennineanimalwelfaresociety.org/events; charity background: https://www.pennineanimalwelfaresociety.org/our-story
